figures.title: ABACUS 弹性常数计算学习路线图
figures.caption: 本教程的四个核心学习阶段示意图：从弹性力学理论基础出发，经历计算准备与基准构建，通过单质硅（Si）掌握标准工作流，最后深入二氧化钛（TiO₂）处理复杂的各向异性与原子弛豫问题。
source_quotes: 第一章：回顾弹性力学基础，重点阐述广义胡克定律
第二章：聚焦计算准备，强调“零应力”基准
第三章：以单质硅（Si）为例，演示结合 `abacustest` 自动化工具
第四章：深入探讨金红石型二氧化钛（TiO₂），解析非立方晶系的各向异性
labels_required: 各向异性 & 原子弛豫
assertions: Figure must contain 4 distinct blocks arranged horizontally or vertically.
Arrows must connect Chapter 1 to 2, 2 to 3, and 3 to 4.
Chapter 3 block must visually reference Silicon.
Chapter 4 block must visually reference TiO2.

chapters.chapter_title: **第一章：弹性力学**​**基础与计算原理**

figures.title: Voigt 记号下标映射与矩阵降维示意图
figures.caption: 本图展示了如何利用 Voigt 记号将二阶应力/应变张量的双下标（ij）映射为单下标（1-6），从而将四阶弹性刚度张量简化为 6×6 矩阵。左侧展示了张量下标到 Voigt 下标的对应规则，下方展示了简化后的广义胡克定律矩阵形式。
source_quotes: 利用应力和应变的对称性（\$\sigma_{ij}=\sigma_{ji}\$，\$\varepsilon_{ij}=\varepsilon_{ji}\$），我们可以使用 **Voigt 记号** 将下标简化
xx \rightarrow 1
通过这种映射，四阶张量被“降维”为一个 6 \times 6 的对称矩阵 \$C_{ij}\$
assertions: 图中必须清晰展示 xx对应1, yy对应2, zz对应3, yz对应4, xz对应5, xy对应6 的映射关系
必须展示 6x6 的矩阵结构
figures.prompt:
Subject: A mathematical schematic diagram illustrating the Voigt Notation mapping rule and the resulting matrix equation.

Visual Elements:
- Top Section (The Mapping Logic):
  - Left Group: A text block labeled "张量下标 (Tensor)" listing the index pairs vertically: "xx, yy, zz, yz, xz, xy".
  - Center Arrow: A wide arrow pointing right, labeled "降维映射".
  - Right Group: A text block labeled "Voigt 下标" listing single numbers vertically: "1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6".
  - Visual Connection: Draw thin connecting lines between "xx" and "1", "yy" and "2", etc., to emphasize the correspondence.

- Bottom Section (The Resulting Equation):
  - Display the matrix equation: [Stress Vector] = [6x6 Stiffness Matrix] * [Strain Vector].
  - The 6x6 Matrix ($C_{ij}$) should be the central visual anchor, clearly showing rows and columns (e.g., $C_{11}$ to $C_{66}$).
  - Label the large matrix as "弹性刚度矩阵 Cij".

Style:
- Background: Pure white.
- Color Scheme: Navy blue for matrix brackets and text, Red for mapping arrows/highlights.
- Typography: Serif font for mathematical symbols (LaTeX style), Sans-serif for Chinese labels.
- Layout: Clean, symmetrical, high-contrast academic textbook style.
figures.negative_prompt: handwritten, blackboard style, messy lines, low resolution, 3d effects, colorful background

figures.title: 第一性原理计算中的原子弛豫机制对比：Clamped-ion vs. Relaxed-ion
figures.caption: 该图对比了在施加晶格形变后，两种不同的原子处理方式。左图（Clamped-ion）显示晶胞拉伸但原子相对坐标被冻结，导致非物理的高能态；右图（Relaxed-ion）显示在保持晶胞形变的同时允许原子弛豫到新的平衡位置，这才是计算弹性常数所需的正确状态。
figures.insert_after_heading: ### **1.2.2 原子弛豫的重要性 (Relaxed-ion vs. Clamped-ion)**
source_quotes: Clamped-ion（钳制离子）... 相当于把原子“冻”住了
Relaxed-ion（松弛离子）... 允许原子在新的晶胞形状下移动，寻找新的受力平衡位置
需要计算的是​**松弛离子弹性常数**
assertions: 必须包含三个状态：初始、钳制、松弛
钳制状态下原子位置仅仅是随晶胞拉伸
松弛状态下原子必须显示出相对于晶胞的局部微调移动
figures.prompt:
Subject: A comparative schematic of crystal lattice deformation modes: Clamped-ion vs. Relaxed-ion.

Visual Elements:
- Layout: Three horizontal panels showing a 2D crystal lattice (balls and sticks).

- Panel 1 (Left): Label "初始结构 (Equilibrium)". Shows a perfect square lattice. Atoms are evenly spaced.

- Panel 2 (Center): Label "钳制离子 (Clamped-ion)".
  - The lattice box is stretched horizontally (rectangular shape).
  - The atoms are stretched proportionally with the box (fractional coordinates fixed).
  - Add a red cross (X) or warning icon.
  - Annotation: "错误做法 (scf)" and "原子坐标不变".
  - Visual cue: Faint red arrows on atoms indicating unbalanced internal forces.

- Panel 3 (Right): Label "松弛离子 (Relaxed-ion)".
  - The lattice box is stretched horizontally (same shape as Center).
  - The internal atoms have shifted slightly from the grid lines (finding new equilibrium).
  - Add a green checkmark.
  - Annotation: "正确做法 (relax)" and "内部原子弛豫".
  - Visual cue: Small curved arrows showing atoms moving to comfortable positions.

Style:
- Flat scientific vector art.
- Atoms: Simple colored circles (e.g., Teal).
- Bonds: Thin grey lines.
- Highlights: Red for error/stress, Green for correct/relaxed.
- Background: White.
figures.negative_prompt: 3d render, perspective distortion, gradient background, noisy, artistic sketch

chapters.chapter_title: **第二章：计算准备——构建“零应力”基准**

figures.title: 原胞与惯用胞的坐标系对齐对比
figures.caption: 展示了在计算弹性常数时，原胞（Primitive Cell）与惯用胞（Conventional Cell）相对于笛卡尔坐标系的几何关系。左侧原胞基矢非正交，导致施加单轴应变时产生复杂的混合分量；右侧惯用胞基矢天然对齐坐标轴，沿轴向的拉伸直接对应物理直观的弹性常数分量。
source_quotes: 原胞：基矢量是非正交的，与笛卡尔坐标轴不重合。
惯用胞：其晶格矢量（Lattice Vectors）天然沿着 x, y, z 轴方向
沿 x 轴拉伸直接对应 \epsilon_{11}，得到的应力响应直接对应 C_{11}。
assertions: Left panel shows a rhombohedral-like cell with vectors misaligned to axes.
Right panel shows a cubic cell with vectors aligned to axes.
X, Y, Z axes are clearly visible in both panels.
figures.prompt:
Subject: A comparative scientific schematic illustrating the geometric alignment of Primitive Cell vs. Conventional Cell relative to Cartesian axes.

Visual Elements:
- Layout: Split into two side-by-side panels. Left panel title: "原胞 (Primitive)". Right panel title: "惯用胞 (Conventional)".
- Coordinate System: Both panels feature a clear 3D Cartesian coordinate system with arrows labeled x, y, z.
- Left Panel Content: A schematic Crystal structure (e.g., FCC primitive) represented as a rhombohedron. Its lattice vectors (arrows a1, a2, a3) are shown at angles (non-orthogonal) and clearly do NOT align with the x, y, z axes. A text annotation below says "非正交基矢 (Non-orthogonal)" and "复杂变换 (Complex Transform)".
- Right Panel Content: A cubic Crystal structure. Its lattice vectors (arrows a, b, c) are perfectly parallel to the x, y, z axes. A red arrow indicates stretching along the x-axis. A text annotation below says "基矢平行坐标轴 (Aligned)" and "直接对应 C11 (Direct C11)".

Style:
- Academic publication style, flat 3D vector graphics.
- Clean white background.
- Color coding: Blue for the crystal lattice, Black for coordinate axes, Red for strain/force arrows.
- High contrast, legible typography.
figures.negative_prompt: photorealistic, blurry, messy, handwritten text, dark background, complex textures

figures.title: 消除残余应力的高精度优化流程
figures.caption: 构建“零应力”基准的计算工作流。流程从含有高残余应力的初始结构开始，通过设置严格收敛标准（如 scf_thr < 1e-8）的变胞弛豫（cell-relax），最终获得应力张量几乎为零的完美晶格，防止虚假物理响应。
source_quotes: 直接使用文件中的结构会导致巨大的内应力。
我们需要使用 ABACUS 进行变胞弛豫（Variable Cell Relaxation）。
scf_thr 1.0e-8
stress_thr 0.1
确认最后一步的应力张量（Stress Tensor）是否接近于 0。
assertions: Flow moves from left (high stress) to right (zero stress).
Central part highlights specific calculation parameters.
Visual distinction between 'distorted/stressed' and 'perfect' states.
figures.prompt:
Subject: A scientific process flow diagram showing the workflow for eliminating residual stress in crystal structures using ABACUS.

Visual Elements:
- Step 1 (Left): An icon representing a "Initial Structure". Visual cues (like small red tension arrows) imply internal stress. Label: "初始结构 (CIF)" and sub-label "残余应力 > 0.1 GPa".
- Transition (Center): A large, sleek arrow pointing from left to right. Inside or above the arrow, a gear icon representing processing. Label: "变胞弛豫 (cell-relax)".
- Parameter Box (Connected to Center): A callout box listing key settings: "scf_thr = 1e-8", "force_thr = 1e-2", "stress_thr ≈ 0". Label this box "高精度参数 (High Precision)".
- Step 2 (Right): An icon representing the "Reference Structure". It looks perfectly cubic and orderly, surrounded by a calm blue aura or checkmark. Label: "基准结构 (Reference)" and sub-label "零应力状态 (Zero Stress)".
- Bottom Chart (Optional inset): A small, stylized line graph showing "Stress" on Y-axis dropping to zero over "Steps" on X-axis.

Style:
- Professional technical diagram.
- White background.
- Color palette: Transition from Red (Stress) to Blue/Green (Relaxed/Correct).
- Clean lines, sans-serif fonts for labels.
figures.negative_prompt: chaotic, hand-drawn, abstract art, screen capture, interface elements

chapters.chapter_title: **第三章：标准工作流**​​**实战——以硅（Si**​**）为例**

figures.title: 结构预优化：从初始态到零应力基态
figures.caption: ABACUS 结构优化原理示意图。通过 cell-relax 模式，同时调整原子位置（Ions）和晶胞形状（Cell），使系统沿着势能面下降，直到达到受力极小且内应力（Stress）接近于 0 的基态结构。这是计算弹性常数的必要前提。
source_quotes: 在施加应变之前，必须确保初始结构处于“零应力”的基态。
我们需要同时优化晶胞形状（Cell）和原子位置（Ions），以消除所有内应力。
force_thr_ev: 0.01
stress_thr: 0.1
assertions: 图中应包含一个势能曲线或势能面示意。
左侧应表示不稳定的初始结构，右侧表示稳定的基态结构。
箭头应指示从高能态向低能态的演化。
figures.prompt:
Subject: A conceptual schematic illustrating the structural relaxation process in computational materials science.

Visual Elements:
- Background: A clean 2D plot area representing Potential Energy Surface (a smooth curve dipping into a well).
- Y-axis: Label "系统能量 (Energy)".
- X-axis: Label "晶格参数/几何构型 (Geometry)".
- Element 1 (Top Left): An icon of a Silicon crystal lattice with slight red distortion lines, labeled "初始结构 (高应力)".
- Element 2 (Bottom Center): An icon of a perfect, symmetric Silicon crystal lattice sitting at the bottom of the energy well, labeled "基态结构 (零应力)".
- Action: A curved dashed arrow connecting Element 1 to Element 2, following the slope of the energy curve. Label the arrow "abacustest cell-relax".
- Annotation: Near the bottom well, add text "Stress < 0.1 KBar" and "Force < 0.01 eV/Å".

Style: Academic diagram style, flat design, white background. Use blue for the energy curve and structure icons, red for stress indicators. High contrast, clean sans-serif typography.

figures.title: abacustest 弹性任务生成工作流
figures.caption: 由基准结构自动生成批量变形任务的目录树结构示意图。abacustest 工具读取优化后的 STRU 文件，根据设定的正应变（norm）和剪切应变（shear）参数，自动生成包含原始结构（org）和多个变形结构（deform-xx）的独立计算文件夹。
source_quotes: abacustest model elastic prepare -j Si-elastic --norm 0.01 --shear 0.01
org/: 原始结构的计算任务（作为基准）。
deform-01/到deform-23：施加了不同大小和不同形变的结构
labels_required: 输入: 优化后的 STRU
assertions: 中心或顶部应为输入的 STRU 文件。
应发散出多个文件夹图标。
需区分 org 文件夹和 deform 文件夹。
figures.prompt:
Subject: A hierarchical workflow diagram showing the file generation process for elastic constant calculation.

Visual Elements:
- Root Node (Top): A folder icon labeled "Si-elastic/" containing a file icon labeled "STRU (基态)".
- Process Node (Middle): A gear or action arrow labeled "自动生成 (abacustest prepare)".
- Output Nodes (Bottom): A branching tree structure leading to multiple folder icons.
  - Branch 1: Folder labeled "org/" with a sub-label "基准结构 (无应变)".
  - Branch 2: Folder labeled "deform-01/" with a small icon showing a cube stretched along one axis. Label: "正应变 (Normal)".
  - Branch 3: Folder labeled "deform-xx/" with a small icon showing a cube tilted/sheared. Label: "剪切应变 (Shear)".
  - Visual Hint: Use '...' between deform-01 and deform-xx to imply multiple folders (01 to 23).

Style: Clean technical diagram, flat vector graphics. Use distinct colors for folders (e.g., yellow/orange) and process arrows (grey/blue). White background, professional font.

figures.title: 硅的弹性刚度张量矩阵可视化
figures.caption: 基于计算结果拟合得到的硅（立方晶系）弹性刚度张量 $C_{ij}$ 矩阵热力图。图中清晰展示了三个独立分量：对角线上的 $C_{11}$（轴向刚度），非对角线的 $C_{12}$（横向耦合），以及右下角的 $C_{44}$（剪切刚度）。其余分量均为 0，符合立方晶系的对称性。
source_quotes: elastic_tensor:
C_{11}: 代表沿轴向拉伸的刚度。这里 =155.5 GPa
C_{12}: 代表泊松效应导致的横向耦合。这里 =58.2 GPa
C_{44}: 代表剪切变形的刚度。这里 =76.2 GPa
assertions: 必须展示 6x6 的矩阵网格。
非零元素的位置必须符合立方晶系特征（对角线前3，交叉前3x3，对角线后3）。
数值应与文本中的结果一致。
figures.prompt:
Subject: A scientific matrix visualization (heatmap style) of the 6x6 Elastic Stiffness Tensor for Silicon.

Visual Elements:
- Structure: A 6x6 grid representing the matrix indices 1 to 6 (or 0 to 5).
- Color Coding (Values):
  - Diagonal Cells (1,1), (2,2), (3,3): Deep Blue squares. Label inside: "C11\n155.5".
  - Off-Diagonal Cells (1,2), (1,3), (2,1), (2,3), (3,1), (3,2): Medium Blue squares. Label inside: "C12\n58.3".
  - Shear Diagonal Cells (4,4), (5,5), (6,6): Light Blue squares. Label inside: "C44\n76.2".
  - All other cells: Very light grey or white. Label inside: "0".
- Annotations:
  - A bracket on the left grouping rows 1-3 labeled "正应力分量 (Normal)".
  - A bracket on the left grouping rows 4-6 labeled "剪切应力分量 (Shear)".
  - Legend: "单位: GPa".

Style: Academic publication quality. Sharp grid lines, clean sans-serif text centered in each cell. Monochromatic blue scale for values to represent magnitude (Darker = Higher Stiffness). White background.

chapters.chapter_title: ​**第四章：进阶案例与各向异性**​**——金红石型 TiO2**

figures.title: 金红石型 TiO2 晶体结构与四方晶系弹性矩阵
figures.caption: 左图展示了金红石型二氧化钛（Rutile TiO2）的四方晶胞结构，钛原子位于中心及顶点，氧原子呈八面体配位。右图为四方晶系（Laue class I）的弹性常数矩阵形式，高亮显示了 6 个独立的弹性常数（C11, C12, C13, C33, C44, C66），体现了其各向异性特征。
figures.insert_after_heading: ## **4.2 独立弹性常数分析与实验对比**
source_quotes: 金红石型 TiO₂ 属于四方晶系（Laue class I）
它具有 ​**6 个独立弹性常数**​
assertions: 左侧显示晶体球棍模型，右侧显示6x6矩阵
矩阵中应当只有上三角或对称显示非零项
C11与C22应当标记为相同颜色或符号
figures.prompt: Subject: A dual-panel scientific illustration. Left panel: 3D Ball-and-stick crystal structure model of Rutile TiO2. Titanium atoms are silver/grey spheres, Oxygen atoms are red spheres. The unit cell is a rectangular prism (tetragonal, c-axis longer than a-axis), outlined in black lines. Label 'Ti 原子' pointing to a grey sphere, 'O 原子' pointing to a red sphere. Vertical axis labeled 'c-axis'. Right panel: A 6x6 matrix grid representation of the Elastic Tensor. The matrix entries are text. Diagonal elements: C11, C11, C33, C44, C44, C66. Off-diagonal: C12, C13 (symmetric). Zeros in other positions. Highlight the independent constants (C11, C12, C13, C33, C44, C66) with a light blue background fill. Label above matrix: '四方晶系矩阵'. Style: Clean white background, academic publication standard, flat design for the matrix, high-quality 3D render look for the atoms.

figures.title: abacustest 弹性常数计算自动化工作流
figures.caption: 基于 abacustest 的弹性常数计算全流程示意图。流程从初始 CIF 结构出发，经过高精度结构优化（Cell Relax），自动生成多组变形结构（Prepare），批量提交 SCF 计算，最后进行后处理拟合（Post-process）得到弹性模量张量。
source_quotes: 使用 `abacustest` 自动化完成“施加应变 -> 生成文件 -> 提交计算”的全流程
第一步：准备结构
第二步：执行高精度结构优化
abacustest model elastic prepare
abacustest model elastic post
assertions: 流程必须是线性的或循序渐进的
包含5个主要步骤节点
最后一步指向结果输出

figures.title: 金红石 TiO2 弹性常数：计算值与实验值对比
figures.caption: 本教程计算得到的弹性常数（蓝色柱状图）与实验测量值（灰色柱状图）的对比。结果显示 C33 具有显著的最大值，体现了沿 c 轴方向的高刚度。计算结果与实验吻合良好，验证了方法的准确性。
source_quotes: 将结果与 Physics and Chemistry of Minerals 26, 31 (1998) 中的实验结果对比
assertions: 包含6组数据
C33应当是最高的柱子，接近500
每组包含两个柱子（计算vs实验）
figures.prompt:
Subject: A grouped bar chart comparing calculated vs experimental elastic constants for Rutile TiO2. Visual Elements:
- X-axis: Categories labeled 'C11', 'C12', 'C13', 'C33', 'C44', 'C66'.
- Y-axis: Label '弹性常数 / Elastic Constant (GPa)'. Scale from 0 to 600.
- Data Series 1 (Blue bars): Label '计算值 (This Work)'. Values: C11~281, C12~158, C13~156, C33~484, C44~117, C66~216.
- Data Series 2 (Grey bars): Label '实验值 (Exp.)'. Values: C11~268, C12~175, C13~147, C33~484, C44~124, C66~190.
